title: Source-only localization compatibility of the sectionwise image comparison
statement: Let h:X→Y, W⊆Y, I a K-injective complex on X such that j_{h⁻¹W,*}r_{h⁻¹W}I is K-injective, and e:QI≅E any representation. Use [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data] and [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Starting at Rh_* of the derived open image of E, transport by e.inv and the inverse open-image computation, then the direct-image computation and the localized sectionwise isomorphism, then the general open-image localization map on h_*I. This composite equals schemeMVOpenComparison(h,W,E) followed by the derived open-image functor applied to Rh_*(e.inv) followed by the computation isomorphism of I. There is no target resolution or normalized chain map in this statement.

proof.text: Use the composition-side localization identity on I. Its right side retains Rj_W of the explicit restriction-localization chain followed by the inverse derived restriction comparison; this identity comes from composition-unit normalization and postcomposition, without using restriction-unit normalization.

Rewrite the unnormalized restriction chain using the independent inverse-normalized restriction identity. Functor.comp_map then identifies Rj_W of derived Y-restriction of the h-unit with the derived open-image functor applied to that unit. This gives the general image-unit square without K-injectivity.

On the two K-injective source complexes replace localization units by inverse computation isomorphisms and open-image localization by its computation isomorphism. Precompose and postcompose the unit square with inverse factors and cancel. Finally transport from QI to E using naturality of the canonical open comparison. The naturality lemma is proved for abstract functors in exactly the comparison expression shape, then specialized.

theorem schemeMV_image_localization_compatibility
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] [(schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I).IsKInjective]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ E) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let H := (schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y W) ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map
        ((((schemeMVDerivedRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)) ⋙
            schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map e.inv) ≫
          (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I
            (schemeMVAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W))).inv) ≫
      (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso h.toLRSHom.toShHom
        (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I)).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeMVImageComponent h W I (F.obj I) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      schemeMVOpenImageLocalization Y W (F.obj I) =
    (schemeMVOpenComparison h W E).hom ≫
      H.map ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map e.inv ≫
        (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso h.toLRSHom.toShHom I).hom)
